ARCH §2 puts server/db/pglite.js in the layout, but the import list of ARCH §2.2 for server/** does not name @electric-sql/pglite. REQ-108 criterion 3 allows it in app/server/db/pglite.js only (and it is a dev dependency by criterion 1, so production never loads it: criterion 4 requires DATABASE_URL with NODE_ENV=production). ORCH may record it as a Plan amendment row.

ARCH §19.2 writes the rewrite as {source: "/api/(.*)", destination: "/api"}; the lesson in PROGRESS «Log» of 2026-10-31 (learned and checked live on another Vercel project) gives /api/:path* -> /api/index?__p=:path* with a nested address in the smoke. REQ-109 takes the measured form as the default of question О4; if ORCH accepts it, a Plan amendment row for ARCH §19.2 is needed. Both forms stay unmeasured in Sai until spike S1.

ARCH §18 triggers app.yml only on a push to main (with a paths filter), while decisions/0110 asks for the GitHub evidence of a run before the push to main, from a temporary ci/* branch. With the ARCH trigger the pg and docker criteria of REQ-108 (11, 12) and REQ-109 (6) could be proved only after the push. REQ-108 criterion 11 takes «main and ci/**» as the default of question О1; a Plan amendment row is needed if accepted.

ARCH §14.1 says «no Server or X-Powered-By»; whether Vercel adds its own Server header to static and function answers is not in the pages read and not measured. A smoke that demands no Server header could fail the first production check for a reason the code cannot change. Question О7; the production value goes into the post-deploy record.

ARCH §3 adopts a version only with the licence MIT, ISC, BSD or Apache-2.0. Measured on the same lint set in tools/package-lock.json: minimatch 10.2.6 is BlueOak-1.0.0 (dev). A criterion over every package of the lockfile would be impossible with eslint 10.11.0 (AP-016, AP-127), so REQ-108 criterion 1 binds the direct dependencies, and question О14 asks how the transitive exceptions are recorded (default: the design and an Addition to decisions/0001).

Q4 for the gate: by decisions/0001 item 2 the one check command of app/ is that of ARCH §3 (format, lint, types, check-public, vendored, content, unit, int); test:pg (real Postgres 17) and the Docker parity run only as jobs of app.yml (REQ-108 criteria 8, 11, 12; REQ-109 6), because the Mac has neither Postgres nor Docker by default (G15). This follows the recorded decision; REQ-VALIDATOR may want to confirm it is not read as «some tests outside the one command».

О1 — triggers of app.yml. Default: `push` to `main` and to `ci/**`, with the paths filter of ARCH §18, so the jobs pg and docker give their evidence on the temporary branch before the push to main (decisions/0110). Alternative: main only (ARCH §18); then REQ-108 criteria 11-12 and REQ-109 criterion 6 are proved only after the push.

О2 — jobs of app.yml in R1.1. Default: exactly check, pg, docker; the job e2e comes with the first browser test of app/ (R1.2), migration-rehearsal with the requirement that seeds a database through the chain (ARCH §20.4). Alternative: all five jobs now, two of them with nothing to test.

О3 — browser tests of app/. Default: REQ-108 and REQ-109 bring no automated browser test (the M1.3 test list has none); the tool for later ones (the own kit tools/test/e2e/kit/ or playwright-core) is chosen by a decision record in the design of M1.3, as PROGRESS «Open problems» (2026-11-17) says; neither is forbidden. Note: the boundary of decisions/0107 names only REQ-104…REQ-107 for browser tests inside the tools check; the app check is under decisions/0001, which lists playwright-core.

О4 — the rewrite and the entry shape. Default: vercel.json has exactly {"source": "/api/:path*", "destination": "/api/index?__p=:path*"}; app/api/index.js restores the path from `__p` and also accepts the plain path; the export form (the app's fetch as the default export, or `handle` of `hono/vercel`) is chosen by the design, and only in the second case may api/index.js import `hono/vercel`. Spike S1 confirms on the owner's project after G4; a correction after S1 is a WF-03 defect (PLAN M1.2). Alternative: the ARCH §19.2 form.

О5 — the body of /api/health. Default: exactly the keys ok, db, role, migrations_pending, version, node; 200 when all are right, 503 otherwise with ok false; version = APP_VERSION, or `dev` when unset; node = process.version. A rename by the design only through a micro-amendment.

О6 — SITE_GATE. Default: unset or empty = open; `closed` and any other non-empty value close the site (fail closed, ARCH §0 item 4); the gate answer has status 503 (JSON with one key error for /api, one HTML page otherwise). On Vercel the static files are closed by vercel-build, which leaves only the gate page in the output folder when SITE_GATE=closed (REQ-109 criterion 8), and the function answers 503; the redeploy is the owner's step in incident.md. Alternative: route every path through the function while closed (not possible with a static vercel.json without another build output). A production drill of the owner's steps is not in the first post-deploy record by default; ORCH may offer it in report #M1.

О7 — the Server header. Default: Node and Docker answers carry no Server and no X-Powered-By (tests); the smoke fails on X-Powered-By on any base and on a Server value that has a digit (a version); the production headers are written in the post-deploy record; if Vercel adds a Server header that cannot be removed, ORCH writes a Plan amendment row for ARCH §14.1.

О8 — the preview-host rule of vercel.json. Default: no `redirects` rule in REQ-109, because the preview host name is known only at G4 and the second domain is added after it (ARCH §19.1, S2); the rule and its test come with S2 (a WF-03 defect or a micro-amendment); the Node side of the preview host is REQ-108 criterion 4; the smoke's --preview is optional. Alternative: a placeholder host name in vercel.json now (not recommended: a placeholder in a production file).

О9 — the language of the runbooks. Default: English files (decisions/0080, Sai documents), with the owner's steps (SITE_GATE, Instant Rollback) as a section in Russian (decisions/0080 item 3: what the owner reads; precedent docs/program/public-v1/vercel-setup.ru.md). Alternative: all English, or the owner's steps in a separate .ru.md file.

О10 — the local database and PGlite. Default: with no DATABASE_URL and NODE_ENV other than production, node-main uses an in-memory PGlite (nothing kept, nothing written into the Sai folder) and runs the migration at its start; with NODE_ENV=production DATABASE_URL is required (REQ-108 criterion 4). Not measured: whether PGlite runs CREATE ROLE and which role its session has (likely a superuser, which the selfcheck would refuse). The design measures both and names the reading that the selfcheck and /api/health use on PGlite; the refusal on Postgres is never relaxed. If PGlite cannot run 0001 as written, REQ-108 criterion 7 is corrected by a WF-01 micro-amendment before the design gate (AP-127), not inside the design.

О11 — time limits written as literals: the database answer of /api/health 5000 ms; the failure of migrate 15 000 ms; the failure of the smoke 15 000 ms; the exit after SIGTERM 5000 ms. Defaults; the design may make them shorter, a longer one needs a micro-amendment.

О12 — details of check-public. Default: phrases in any letter case and with any whitespace between the words; whole words by identifier borders (AP-120); the value of an xmlns or xmlns:* attribute is not an outside URL; three bans added to the ARCH list (`<style`, `<script` without src, `on…=` attributes), which the CSP would block anyway. Risk for R1.2: the whole-word ban on `decisions` may hit ordinary English page text; R1.2 would then need its own decision with a reason (narrowing a ban is not done silently).

О13 — depends_on of REQ-108. Default: [] with the reason in the comment; the program order (M1 code after the M0 release: REQ-103 and the R0.2 defect ISS-0092, green CI) is kept by ORCH. Alternative: [REQ-103], which encodes the order but names a requirement whose output this work does not use (gate item (в)).

О14 — the licence rule. Default: REQ-108 criterion 1 binds the direct dependencies; every transitive package with another licence is listed with name, version and licence in the design and in an Addition to decisions/0001 (measured 2026-11-17: minimatch 10.2.6 BlueOak-1.0.0 in the same lint set of tools/). Alternative: every package of the lockfile — impossible with eslint 10.11.0 as measured.
О15 — the language of the closed page. Default: Russian only (lang="ru", the words «Sai — закрытое тестирование» of PLAN M1.7); en and kk come with R1.2. Alternative: ru and en now.
О16 — rows of platform_settings after migration 0001. Default: none (its keys are used from M4/M5). Alternative: seed test_mode and kill_switch now.

For Q12 the route of the run already says «ORCH answers the open questions (decision record)» before REQ-VALIDATOR: one record (next free number by `ls decisions | sort | tail -1`, now after 0115) with the answers to О1-О16, plus Plan amendment rows in PROGRESS.md for the ARCH deviations of I4-I7 if the defaults are taken.
